article.story: JONESBORO, Ark. -- — Jalen Hampton's 17 points and 13 rebounds helped Arkansas State defeat Southern Miss 89-84 on Tuesday night. Joey Chammaa scored all 15 of his points from the free-throw line for the Red Wolves (19-11, 10-7 Sun Belt Conference). Christian Harmon had 14 points and shot 3 of 8 from the field, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 7 from the line. Tylik Weeks finished with 21 points and nine assists for the Golden Eagles (15-15, 8-9). Southern Miss also got 20 points, four assists and four steals from Isaac Tavares. Djahi Binet finished with 16 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
